question: Mb in computer language is the abbreviation of which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Megabit**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mb** in computer language stands for **Megabit**.
 
• A **Megabit** is a unit of data measurement equal to 1,000,000 bits or 1,024 kilobits.
 
• It is often used to measure data transfer speeds of internet connections or digital communication systems.
 
• Unlike **Megabyte (MB)**, which is a unit of data storage, **Megabit (Mb)** is typically used to quantify data transfer rates.
 
• For example, an internet speed of 100 Mbps means 100 Megabits per second.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Megabyte (MB)** is often confused with **Megabit (Mb)**. One Megabyte is equal to 8 Megabits.
 
• The distinction is important when considering internet speeds and data storage capacities.
 
• For instance, a file that is 1 Megabyte in size would take 8 seconds to download on a 1 Megabit per second (Mbps) connection.
 
• Understanding the difference between these units helps in making informed decisions regarding internet plans and data usage.
